provenance.method_10_as_printed: page 5: '8. Method based on Wilson score interval for the single proportion without continuity correction. Interval is theta-hat - delta to theta-hat + epsilon where delta = sqrt(dl2^2 - 2 phi-hat dl2 du3 + du3^2), epsilon = sqrt(du2^2 - 2 phi-hat du2 dl3 + dl3^2). Here dl2 = (e+f)/n - l2, du2 = u2 - (e+f)/n where l2 and u2 are roots of |pi - (e+f)/n| = z sqrt(pi(1-pi)/n). Likewise dl3 = (e+g)/n - l3, du3 = u3 - (e+g)/n ... Also phi-hat = (eh - fg)/sqrt((e+f)(g+h)(e+g)(f+h)), but phi-hat = 0 if this denominator is 0.' ... '10. Method using score intervals but continuity corrected phi-hat: as method 8 above, but with the numerator of phi-hat replaced by max(eh - fg - n/2, 0) if eh > fg.' (theta = pi2 - pi3, estimated by (f - g)/n, Table I)
